title: Quasi-coherent derived objects lift across a quasi-compact open of an affine scheme
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U be a quasi-compact open subscheme, and let E be an object of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category]. There exists E' in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) whose restriction to U is isomorphic to E.

source.place: Tag 08EE proof, invocation of Lemma lemma-lift-quasi-coherent

proof.text: Put j = U.ι. The compactness hypothesis gives CompactSpace U by isCompact_iff_compactSpace. Since the affine scheme X is quasi-separated, Mathlib quasiCompact_of_compactSpace supplies QuasiCompact j; an open immersion is quasi-separated. Let E' be the explicit object Rj_*E. Apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] to E.property to equip this object with quasi-coherent cohomology.

source.place: Tag 08EE proof, invocation of Lemma lemma-lift-quasi-coherent

proof.text: Let F be moduleDirectImage j and G be overFunctor U followed by the canonical overEquiv U. Mathlib Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv identifies G with restrictFunctor j, and Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso gives F composed with G isomorphic to the identity. Derive this underived natural isomorphism using the proved source-library API: the inverse of rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso F G, followed by rightDerivedFunctorNatIso, then rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory for the identity and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. These four isomorphisms identify Rj_* followed by derived restriction with the identity. Evaluate at E.obj and pair this isomorphism with the quasi-coherent object of step 1. This treats the empty open and the whole open without a separate case and uses no choices of objects from unproved existence statements.

lean.statement: theorem exists_qc_derived_lift_of_isCompact_open (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory U.toScheme) : ∃ E' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Nonempty (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙ Equivalence.functor (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E'.obj ≅ E.obj)
